quote_volume_std.name: Quote Volume Standard Deviation
quote_volume_std.comment: Rolling standard deviation of Close * Volume proxy

positive_amplitude_rank.name: Positive Amplitude Rank
positive_amplitude_rank.comment: Rolling percentile rank of positive-price-change amplitude mean

apz_width.name: Adaptive Price Zone Width
apz_width.comment: Double EMA high-low volatility divided by double EMA close

pac_width_bias.name: Price Acceleration Channel Width Bias
pac_width_bias.comment: PAC width divided by rolling mean PAC width minus 1

env_position.name: Envelope Channel Position
env_position.comment: Close position inside +/-5 percent moving-average envelope

adaptive_bollinger_width.name: Adaptive Bollinger Width
adaptive_bollinger_width.comment: Adaptive z-score Bollinger bandwidth normalized by close moving average

vwap_bbw_efficiency.name: VWAP BBW Efficiency
vwap_bbw_efficiency.comment: Rolling VWAP change times Bollinger-width change normalized by quote-volume proxy

chaikin_volatility.name: Chaikin Volatility
chaikin_volatility.comment: Rate of change of EMA high-low range

realized_volatility.name: Realized Volatility
realized_volatility.comment: Rolling standard deviation of one-bar returns

rwi.name: Random Walk Index Composite
rwi.comment: Close normalized within upward/downward Random Walk Index range

mssi.name: Market Sentiment Stability Index
mssi.comment: Max of average drawdown from rolling high and reverse drawdown from rolling low

keltner_width.name: Keltner Width

fibonacci_band_width.name: Fibonacci Band Width

fibonacci_band_position.name: Fibonacci Band Position

atr_micro.name: Micro Average True Range

atr_short.name: Short Average True Range
atr_short.comment: atr = ta.atr(high, low, close, length=n) with n = SHORT_LOOKBACK

atr_long.name: Long Average True Range

atr_macro.name: Macro Average True Range

rwi_low.name: Random Walk Index Low

parkinson_vol.name: Parkinson Volatility
parkinson_vol.comment: Rolling Parkinson (1980) High-Low volatility = sqrt(1/(4*ln(2)*n) * sum(ln(High/Low)^2)) with n = VOLATILITY_LOOKBACK

garman_klass_vol.name: Garman-Klass Volatility
garman_klass_vol.comment: Rolling Garman-Klass (1980) OHLC volatility with n = VOLATILITY_LOOKBACK

rogers_satchell_vol.name: Rogers-Satchell Volatility
rogers_satchell_vol.comment: Rolling Rogers-Satchell (1991) OHLC drift-independent volatility with n = VOLATILITY_LOOKBACK

yang_zhang_vol.name: Yang-Zhang Volatility
yang_zhang_vol.comment: Rolling Yang-Zhang (2000) overnight jump and drift-independent volatility with n = VOLATILITY_LOOKBACK

volatility_ratio_yz.name: Yang-Zhang to Close-to-Close Volatility Ratio
volatility_ratio_yz.comment: Ratio of Yang-Zhang volatility to close-to-close rolling standard deviation

squeeze_on.name: TTM Squeeze On
squeeze_on.comment: True when Bollinger Bands are completely inside Keltner Channel (ub < kc_upper and lb > kc_lower)

squeeze_off.name: TTM Squeeze Off
squeeze_off.comment: True when Bollinger Bands expand outside Keltner Channel (~squeeze_on)

squeeze_count.name: TTM Squeeze Consecutive Count
squeeze_count.comment: Cumulative count of consecutive bars in squeeze_on state

squeeze_momentum.name: TTM Squeeze Momentum
squeeze_momentum.comment: Rolling linear regression slope of Close - (DonchianMid + SMA) / 2 over VOLATILITY_LOOKBACK

hvr.name: Historical Volatility Ratio
hvr.comment: Ratio of short-term HV (SHORT_LOOKBACK) to long-term HV (LONG_LOOKBACK)

rvi_14.name: Relative Volatility Index (14)
rvi_14.comment: Relative Volatility Index (Dorsey, 1993) measuring 10-period standard deviation directionality smoothed over 14-period EMA

is_choppy.name: Choppy Market Regime
is_choppy.comment: True when Choppiness Index chop14 > 61.8 (consolidation / sideway market)

is_trending.name: Trending Market Regime
is_trending.comment: True when Choppiness Index chop14 < 38.2 (strong directional trend)
